title: English Party 邀请函
story: 假定你是李华。你校将举办英语派对（English Party），请给你校外教Chris写一封邮件邀请他参加，内容包括：
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。

step1.main: 李华，本校学生（题干明示）
step1.implied: 以学生个人名义写信——不是官方发布口吻
step1.feelings: 自封头衔（chairman of the Student Union）——题干没给的不能加

step1.implied: 师长 + 英语本族语者：表达习惯按英语书信的路数来
step1.feelings: 人称写成 he/she 第三方（Chris is kind. He can...）——收信人变成了谈论对象

step1.main: 邀请信：邮件邀请 Chris 参加 English Party（题干明示）
step1.implied: 邀请 ≠ 通知 ≠ 倡议——只能恳请，不能布置
step1.feelings: 写成通知口吻（Attention please / Everyone should come）

step1.main: 答题卡书信格式（Dear Chris, / Yours sincerely, / Li Hua 题干已给）
step1.implied: 三件套齐全 + 80 词上限
step1.feelings: 漏落款署名；词数失控（80 写到 120）

step1.main: 让 Chris 参加 Party（题干明示）；潜台词：最好还表演节目（"擅长唱歌"是可用信息）
step1.implied: 任务成功的标准 = Chris 答应来
step1.feelings: 写成活动介绍（I'd like to tell you about...）——目的悄悄降级成了告知

step1.card: 我是李华，以学生身份用邮件邀请外教 Chris 参加 English Party（并期待他表演节目），80 词，书信三件套。
step1.tag: ［半正式偏正式 · 热情留白 · 联结配方：契合＋感情＋身份］
step1.hint: 动笔前默念一遍——这句话就是全篇的锚。语用标签由②四问判定后回填。

step2.q: ① 交际目的：这封信最终要 Chris 做什么？

opts.t: A. 让他知道有这件事（告知型）
opts.why: 写完全文 Chris 只是"知道了"——那是通知的功能，全文没有一处推动行动。

opts.t: B. 让他答应来，最好还愿意表演（促成型）
opts.why: 邀请 = 促成。全文每句都要往"答应"推：安排说清（能来）、理由给足（想来）、回复路径留好（怎么答）。

opts.t: C. 展示我的英语水平（表现型）
opts.why: 堆难词炫技，收信人被无视——交际对象消失了。

opts.t: D. 让他喜欢我（讨好型）
opts.why: 满篇客套吹捧，真正的目的（他来表演）反而失焦。

step2.a: 落点 B。判断法：想象 Chris 读完放下手机——B 型的信让他"想回一句 I'd love to"，A 型只会让他"哦"。四型对照：通知=告知 · 邀请/请求=促成 · 申请=表现 · 道歉=修复。

step2.q: ② 关系定位：李华与 Chris 的关系落在标尺哪一格？

opts.t: A. 正式（对校长 / 陌生机构）
opts.why: 过冷。Chris 是天天见面的外教，不是公文收件人。

opts.t: B. 半正式偏正式（师长：亲切而恭敬）
opts.why: "熟而不友"——认识很久（可亲）＋ 评过我作业（须敬）。亲切可以有（We would be glad），随意不行（Hey / You must）。

opts.t: C. 半正式平视（不熟的家长 / 房东）
opts.why: 少了敬意——师生之间的权力差还在。

opts.t: D. 非正式（好友：Hey, wanna come?）
opts.why: 最高频误判："外教很随和啊"——随和是性格，语域看关系。师长终归是师长。

step2.a: 落点 B。语域标尺四格（正式→非正式）任何题先标位：通知/申请信=正式 · 邀请/感谢师长=偏正式 · 托不熟的人=平视 · 给好友=非正式。

step2.q: ③ 情感分寸：这封信该多"热"？

opts.t: A. 越热越好（满篇感叹、really really want）
opts.why: 热情变成施压——师长被架住了。

opts.t: B. 热在诚意，留白在决定权
opts.why: 热情端：It would be our honor / we would be glad（诚意给足）；恭敬端：Would you be available... / if you could...——虚拟语气 = 把决定权还给对方（他有拒绝权，邀请不施压）。

opts.t: C. 公事公办，零度叙述
opts.why: 信息全对，但不像邀请——像会议通知。

opts.t: D. 卑微恳求（I beg you...）
opts.why: 过谦失度——学生请老师，不是下级求上级。

step2.a: 落点 B。分寸的语法化：虚拟语气就是"恭敬的留白"——形式即功能。

step2.q: ④ 联结路径：靠什么与 Chris 建立联结？

opts.t: A. 讲道理（This party will enrich our school life...）
opts.why: 官方"意义牌"——学生最爱写，对师长最无力：他不需要你告诉他活动有意义。道理是单向输出，不产生联结。

opts.t: B. 给契合（You are good at singing——舞台正好为你而设）
opts.why: 联结通道①：他的特长 × 活动的需求对上号——"这舞台缺你"（被需要）。

opts.t: C. 动感情（We would be glad to have you with us）
opts.why: 联结通道②：真诚的期待感——"我们想有你"。

opts.t: D. 抬身份（It would be our honor if you could...）
opts.why: 联结通道③：特邀感——"您配得上这份邀请"（师长受用的尊重）。

step2.a: 配方 B＋C＋D，道理最多一句背景。三通道记住：契合是"正好"、感情是"想你"、身份是"配您"——通道开一两条，联结就建立；道理牌谁也打不动。

step3.guide: 梯子爬到顶，就是思想性。主体段的得分项不能平铺——沿一把思维阶梯往上爬：层次性是爬的过程，思想性是顶层风景。学生作文"平"，病根是梯子只爬了第一级（罗列事实）从不登顶。四把梯各有适用（卡内标注），80 词的猪肚通常选一把梯爬两三级即可，不必四把全上。

items.name: 深度梯
items.extract: 现象 → 原因 → 本质／价值
items.reuse: You are good at singing（表·契合）→ your song will be the highlight of the party（里·活动价值）→ it will encourage us to explore the beauty of English（顶·学习意义）
items.effect: 适用：分析"为什么喜欢 / 为什么推荐"——三格爬完，一句顶三句。

items.name: 高度梯
items.extract: 个人 → 集体 → 社会／一代人
items.reuse: your performance（个人）→ light up the party for everyone（集体）→ show how music brings us closer（社会·人际）
items.effect: 适用：分析影响、解决方案、意义——视野一格比一格宽。

items.name: 认知梯
items.extract: 了解 → 实践 → 创造
items.reuse: watch English plays（了解）→ sing and perform yourselves（实践）→ create your own short plays（创造）
items.effect: 适用：安排活动、写收获与成长——认知层级逐级抬升。

items.name: 抽象梯
items.extract: 具体事实 → 意义价值
items.reuse: an English Party（事实）→ a window into another culture（意义）→ a chance to think and speak as young global citizens（价值）
items.effect: 适用：结尾升华、点出活动价值——豹尾留余韵的那一句常在这里。

step3.patterns: 登梯衔接句式：What lies behind...（进一层）／ not only..., but also...（双层递进）／ More importantly, ...（抬升）／ It is... that truly matters.（登顶）

build.pick: 本题两个得分点各配一把梯：活动安排 → 认知梯（活动按认知层级排布，"安排感"变"设计感"）；个性化邀请 → 深度梯（从契合爬到意义，一句顶三句）。

steps.sent: You can watch English plays and enjoy poetry reading by our classmates.
Better still, you can sing along and perform with us on stage.
For the boldest, there is even a chance to create your own short plays — the stage is yours.

runs.note: 三格连排 = ranging from...to... 的升级版：活动不再并列堆放，而是逐级深入。这一格格正是③猪肚里的"层次①②"。

runs.point: 个性化邀请 · 升档句

steps.sent: your song will surely be the highlight of the party,
encouraging us to explore the beauty of English through music.

runs.note: 三格用分词结构合成一句——这就是③猪肚里"个性化句"的最终形态：一句顶三句，④的终点产出。

step4.overview: 凤引出来意 → 猪充实理由与安排 → 豹推动行动——80 词三段各有其职，一气贯通。

sections.goal: 3秒定向 + 定调：读信人立刻知道谁、为什么写；第一句就立住语域（承②的判定）
sections.micro: 呼语 →（自我介绍·仅当对方不认识你）→ 目的句 → 背景句
plots: 目的句（开门见山）：I am writing to invite you to... —— 三秒内知道这封信要干什么
背景句（一句即可）：To enrich our campus life... —— 给个理由，不展开
自检：Dear Chris 之后直接入来意？—— 凤头不讲废话、不寒暄凑字

sections.goal: 得分点全展开——读者的所有疑问（几点/哪里/干什么/有什么意思）在此被解决
sections.micro: 总起句 → 层次① → 层次② → 个性化句（层次怎么爬梯 → ④建构要点）
plots: 总起（时间地点四要素）：The party is scheduled for 3-5 pm on Friday, June 5th, in the school hall.
层次①②（活动展开）：There will be a variety of activities, ranging from... to...
个性化句（升档句）：Given your gift for singing, it would be our honor if...
自检：读信人的问句全答完了吗？猪肚要"实·丰·序"

sections.goal: 促成行动（承②促成型目的）+ 留余韵
sections.micro: 行动句（带期限）→ 期待句
plots: 行动句：Please let me know by Wednesday if you can make it.
期待句：Looking forward to your early reply.
自检：结尾是"期待"不是"通知"；不说 Thank you for reading 空客套——豹尾一击即收

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维①内容连贯
step5.bad: I am a student who loves English very much. I want to make friends with you.
step5.good: I am writing to invite you to the English Party to be held in our school.
step5.note: 自我介绍喧宾夺主，邀请信悄悄变成了交友信——回看①的任务卡：一句话锚点不能丢。

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维①内容完整
step5.bad: The party will be very interesting. Please come.
step5.good: The party is scheduled for 3-5 pm on Friday, June 5th, in the school hall, with songs, plays and poetry reading.
step5.note: 时间四要素+活动全无——Chris 想来都不知道几点去哪。

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维⑤格式规范
step5.bad: Attention please! An English Party will be held. Everyone should come.
step5.good: Dear Chris, ... It would be our honor if you could join us. ... Yours sincerely, Li Hua
step5.note: 通知口吻混入邀请信 + 称呼落款全丢——①的 Where? 一问白答了。

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维③得体性
step5.bad: Chris is a good teacher. He can sing well. Students will like him.
step5.good: You are good at singing, and we would love to hear you sing.
step5.note: 收信人被写成"他"——信是写给 you 的，不是谈论 his 的（①易错预警第一条）。

step5.src: 基调病 · 五维③得体性
step5.bad: You must come to our party. It will be good for you.
step5.good: It would be our honor if you could join us.
step5.note: 命令+功利=施压；虚拟语气=恭敬的留白（②情感分寸的落点）。

step5.src: 结构病 · 五维④结构流畅
step5.bad: Our school will hold a party. I hope you can come. It is on Friday. There will be songs. We all like you.
step5.good: 总起（时间地点）→ 层次（活动展开）→ 个性化邀请——凤引出来意、猪充实安排、豹推动行动。
step5.note: 碎片流水账：想到哪写到哪。③的凤猪豹各归其位，脉络才立起来。

step5.src: 结构病 · 五维①内容完整
step5.bad: There will be many activities. There will be English songs. There will be short plays. There will be poetry reading.
step5.good: There will be a variety of activities, ranging from English songs and short plays to poetry reading.
step5.note: 同一句式连发四枪不如 ranging from...to... 一网收拢——猪肚要分层不要分句堆放。

step5.src: 建构病 · 五维②层次性
step5.bad: The party will be very interesting and meaningful. You will have a good time.
step5.good: You can watch English plays, sing along on stage, and even create your own short plays.
step5.note: "有趣""有意义"是贴标签；活动名上句才是内容（④认知梯三格就是反空洞的药）。

checks.q: 活动只写了一项？想想还能加什么

step5.src: 建构病 · 五维②思想性
step5.bad: The party is fun. Fun is good for students.
step5.good: ...encouraging us to explore the beauty of English through music.
step5.note: 梯子只爬第一级就停——爬到顶（意义层），一句顶三句（④深度梯的终点）。

step5.src: 建构病 · 五维②思想性
step5.bad: With the development of society, English is more and more important...
step5.good: When it comes to the liveliest corner of our school, the upcoming English Party springs to my mind.
step5.note: 万金油开头是阅卷疲劳源——从本题的具体情境切入（联结路径的"契合"通道）。

step5.src: 语言病 · 五维③丰富性
step5.bad: The party is good. You can sing. You can play. I hope you come.
step5.good: Given your gift for singing, it would be our honor if you could treat us to an English song.
step5.note: 通篇简单句+good/come——升级路径见⑥语料（Tell➜Show）。

checks.q: 结尾只会 I hope you can come？

step5.src: 语言病 · 五维⑤语法规范
step5.bad: I will invite you to the party. The party was held on Friday.
step5.good: I am writing to invite you... The party is scheduled for Friday...
step5.note: 写信此刻=现在进行（am writing）；活动未办=将来（is scheduled）——"这封信活在什么时间里"动笔前就要定调。

checks.q: invite you join 漏了什么小词？
The party will hold 哪里错了？

qs.q: 目的句起手（功能句 + 虚拟）

corpus.tell: I want to invite you to our party.
corpus.show: I am writing to invite you to the English Party to be held in our school.

corpus.tell: I hope you can come to our party.
corpus.show: I would feel much honored if you could spare some time for our English Party.

qs.q: 背景句（目的状语 + 非谓语后置）

corpus.tell: Our school will have a party.
corpus.show: To enrich our campus life, our school is going to hold an English Party.

corpus.tell: The party is coming and it is interesting.
corpus.show: An English Party is around the corner, aimed at bringing English closer to our daily life.

qs.q: 总起 · 时间地点（被动四要素 + with复合结构）

corpus.tell: The party will hold in our school hall on Friday.
corpus.show: The party is scheduled for 3-5 pm on Friday, June 5th, in the school hall.

corpus.tell: The hall will have many activities.
corpus.show: With a variety of activities lined up, the school hall will be turned into a stage of English.

qs.q: 活动展开（There be + 名词性从句 + 倒装）

corpus.show: There will be a variety of activities, ranging from English songs and short plays to poetry reading.

corpus.tell: I like the drama part best.
corpus.show: What impresses me most is the drama section, where you can watch and even join English plays.

corpus.tell: You can enjoy performances and you can act too.
corpus.show: Not only can you enjoy wonderful performances, but you will also get a chance to act in a short play.

qs.q: 个性化邀请（分词短语 + 强调句 + 虚拟）

corpus.tell: You are good at singing. You can sing a song.
corpus.show: Given your gift for singing, it would be our honor if you could treat us to an English song.

corpus.tell: Your singing will make the party great.
corpus.show: It is your singing that will light up the whole party.

corpus.tell: If you sing a song, the party will be perfect.
corpus.show: If you were to give us a song, the party would be complete.

qs.q: 价值升华（无灵主语 + 介词+which）

corpus.tell: The party can help us learn English.
corpus.show: Your performance will add color to the party and bring English alive for us.

corpus.tell: These activities are useful for us.
corpus.show: Such activities open a window through which we see the beauty of English.

qs.q: 行动句（if宾从 + 期限 + 省略if倒装）

corpus.show: Please let me know by Wednesday if you can make it.

corpus.tell: If you have questions, you can ask me.
corpus.show: Should you have any questions, don't hesitate to write to me.

qs.q: 期待句（动名词惯例 + 虚拟收尾）

corpus.tell: I will be happy if you come.
corpus.show: It would be our great pleasure to see you among us.

step8.text:
Dear Chris,

I am writing to invite you to the English Party to be held in our school.

The party is scheduled for 3:00-5:00 pm on Friday, June 5th, in the school hall. There will be a variety of activities, ranging from English songs and short plays to poetry reading. Given your gift for singing, it would be our honor if you could sing a song for us at the party.

Would you be available for the party? Looking forward to your early reply.

Yours sincerely,
Li Hua

eval.comment: 两要点全覆盖（时间地点四要素＋活动两项），从 invite 开门到 Looking forward 收束无一句偏离任务——①的任务卡在这篇里完整兑现。
活动 ranging from...to... 拉开层次；个性化邀请（your gift for singing）把"请你来"升为"这舞台缺你"——④深度梯的表→里→顶在一句话里走完。
功能句起手（I am writing to invite）＋虚拟语气（it would be our honor if you could）恳请而不施压——对师长语域（②定位）的教科书级示范。
凤15·猪45·豹20（右侧词数体检可验证）：三段各司其职，Given your gift 分词衔接使个性化句嵌得自然，不显突兀。
三件套齐全；时态定调清晰（写信此刻 am writing＋安排将来 is scheduled）；80 词达标——⑤语言病一条不犯。

fuyao: 邀请原因（活动背景一句话）
时间与地点（具体到日期、钟点、地点）
活动安排（≥2 项，有层次）
恳请回复 / 期待参加（礼貌收尾）
